why: Piotr Bacik's arXiv:2409.01221 (Sept 2025, later published) proves decidability of the Skolem Problem for all algebraic linear recurrence sequences of order at most 4, completing a case that was previously open (only order ≤3 and real order-4 were known decidable); the general problem remains open.
